description: Resolve any Indian Supreme Court reference — INSC neutral citation, SCC, AIR, MANU, party name + year, or free text — to the canonical INSC neutral citation with parallel citations, bench, decision date, official e-SCR link, and current treatment status. Use this first for any citation; always prefer and return the INSC form.

query.description: The reference to resolve, e.g. "2013 INSC 768", "(2014) 2 SCC 1", "AIR 2014 SC 187", "Lalita Kumari", "Arnesh Kumar arrest".

name: resolve_citation
